item.title: THE BRAVE AND THE BOLD Reportedly Finds A Writer In THE FLASH And BIRDS OF PREY's Christina Hodson - UPDATE
item.description: Work is progressing slowly on DC Studios' Batman movie, The Brave and the Bold, but it's now been revealed that Christina Hodson (The Flash) is writing the screenplay.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor May Clear Up Some Misconceptions About [SPOILER]'s Return As Spider-Man
item.description: There have been some pretty wild claims circulating about plans for Spider-Man in Avengers: Doomsday this week, but those may have just been cleared up by yet another rumour.

item.title: MERCY Called "Early Contender For Worst Movie Of The Year" In First Reviews; Rotten Tomatoes Score Revealed
item.description: The review embargo for Mercy has lifted, and the verdict is in. So far, critics have not been kind to Amazon MGM's new sci-fi thriller, which is set to hit theaters this weekend...

item.title: VOLTRON Rumor: Henry Cavill's Role Revealed As First Plot Details Tease Battle Between Team Voltron And Zarkon
item.description: A new Voltron rumour includes a synopsis for the upcoming live-action Defender of the Universe adaptation, while Henry Cavill's role in the movie has also been revealed.

item.title: RETURN TO SILENT HILL Rotten Tomatoes Score Revealed As First Reviews Declare It The Worst SILENT HILL Film
item.description: The first reviews are in for Return to Silent Hill, and with that comes a Rotten Tomatoes score that doesn't bode well for the movie's chances of box office success.

item.title: Marvel Comics Revisits CIVIL WAR For Its 20th Anniversary With CIVIL WAR: UNMASKED Limited Series
item.description: This May, Civil War: Unmasked, a new series by Christos Gage and Edgar Salazar, reveals all-new stories set during the explosive era of Marvel Comics' Civil War event.

item.title: STAR WARS Rumor: [SPOILER] Will Have A Huge Role In Simon Kinberg's Trilogy (But Won't Be The Movie's Lead)
item.description: According to a new Star Wars rumour, a familiar face from the franchise's past will have a big role in Simon Kinberg's planned trilogy, but not as the movie's lead character.

item.title: From GREEN LANTERN to DEADPOOL: 8 Actors Who Bounced Back After Comic Book Movie Flops
item.description: Before finding success in subsequent comic book adaptations, a handful of actors starred in truly terrible superhero movies that came close to derailing their respective careers.
